summary: Updates the recommended list of key exchange methods for the Secure Shell (SSH) protocol so they meet stronger security expectations. Key exchange is the step where client and server agree on a secret for the session. The document revises earlier SSH RFCs to say which methods should be used and which should be avoided.

eli5.summary: When two people want a secret handshake, they must first agree how to invent it safely. This note updates the list of safe ways to do that for remote logins.
